market_outlook.short_term: Markets primed for rebound post-Fed day slump (futures rallying). Oil retreat caps inflation scare. Key risk: Trump-Fed conflict escalation could trigger volatility spike. Bond yields near 5% create choppy conditions. Crypto volatile in regulatory vacuum. 1-3 month: range-bound with upside bias if Warsh maintains credibility.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: Structural energy transition (LNG + nuclear) offers durable alpha. 60/40 portfolio requires fundamental redesign at 5% yields. AI capex cycle continues but Burry's slowdown warning warrants caution. India capital markets maturation is multi-year positive. Geopolitical oil fragility and EM stress (Turkey) create episodic risk. Fed independence under political pressure is the defining macro variable.
